scope: Experiments 1-4. Applies to neither confirmatory Final Test evaluation nor collection authorization.
note: Person 1 records these as proposals. A setting becomes approved only when an approver and date are added in a new version of this record. No value below is approved.

settings.proposed_value: Evaluate whether joint verifier-team and aggregation selection provides a useful verification-loss, coverage, and cost tradeoff under declared resource limits and report-corruption scenarios.
settings.rationale: Working claim. It asks for a tradeoff evaluation and does not assert superiority.

The implemented worst_case_expected_loss is the maximum over attacks of Metrics.mean_loss, which includes resource_weight times estimated attempt cost. Decision-only loss remains a required supporting outcome via Metrics.validation_loss. The resource coefficient itself is not proposed as a number until Person 2 costs exist.
Uncalibrated pilot proposal already in research_objective.md. Not a fitted or approved penalty.
The pilot value 0.1/budget changes with the budget and is not usable for Experiment 2. A fixed coefficient on one cost scale is required. No coefficient is invented here.
DecisionEngine default on an uncalibrated signed score. Implementation default, not an approved freeze.

settings.proposed_value: selector difficulty defaults: easy and medium at least 2, hard uses the plan minimum; not the pilot override of 2 for every band
settings.rationale: Matches PlanningContext.minimum_participant_count rather than the unapproved pilot override.

settings.proposed_value: expected-capability team feasibility at planning; achieved-coverage and contributor guards at finalization; no extra percentage floor
settings.rationale: This is the implemented rule. A Development coverage percentage is not proposed.

settings.units: Person 2 measured attempt-cost units, not guessed milliseconds
settings.rationale: Experiment 2 needs about three levels that change feasible teams. Person 2 has not supplied measurements.

proposed_value.severity: full-direction report replacement; not a model or evidence compromise

settings.rationale: Existing enumerator. Suppression mode is the pilot proposal and is not frozen.

settings.proposed_value: Empirical comparisons use shared_unknown: one unresolved component. The two-group registry is a controlled synthetic assumption and is not evidence that verifiers share a real dependency.
settings.rationale: No empirical dependency evidence is in the repository.
Resampling unit is specified. Interval level and draw count are not approved. Zero coverage leaves selective risk undefined.

settings.proposed_value: exploratory operational counts only; no power calculation
settings.rationale: research_v1 Development has 400 groups. The provisional exploratory eligibility audit has 387 paired Development groups. Neither is a power result.
FEVER is a different task and has no evidence text in the current adapter. MultiNLI is not an answer-validation task.

settings.proposed_value: provisional_automated_labeling_v1; SYNTHETIC_INCORRECT is not human ground truth; UNRESOLVED is excluded
